title: Will AI Take My Job?
description: What new research shows about AI, jobs, hiring and wages — measured effects, conflicting findings and changing conclusions.
evidence_scope: Scientific papers, working papers and preprints, with study populations, methods, outcomes and uncertainty recorded.
methodology_summary: Track new and revised studies, separate measured effects from forecasts, compare methods and maintain a cumulative evidence map.
question: What does the latest research actually show about AI’s effects on employment, hiring, wages and the structure of work, and which conclusions change as new evidence arrives?
